svg.text: MIMO regulation boundaries: DC zero, bias and saturation
Normalized continuous LTI; tau=t/(1 s). CSV spacing is not controller sampling.
Fixed bad output port: incompatible r=(1,0), d=0; q grows for every control law
Sensor bias b=[0.2, -0.1]; measured target does not calibrate sensor
Command action: its own vertical scale keeps saturation visible
Actual inputs clipped at +/-0.5; observer receives actual action
Infeasible linear equilibrium: integral states in clipped dynamics; no antiwindup
